name: akbai-delivery
description: AKBai product delivery plugin — 12 role-based AI skills, 15 slash commands, and 2 automated hooks for building, launching, and operating AKBai (Filipino MSME AI business partner).
author: Anton del Rosario

sprint.description: Generate sprint plan with 3-5 tasks sized for 10-15 hrs

standup.description: Generate weekly standup: GitHub comment + build-in-public post

gap-check.description: Review gap registry status, flag overdue items, recommend priorities

retro.description: Sprint retrospective with structured action items

build.description: End-to-end feature build: ADR → schema → code → tests

review.description: Dual code review: quality + security with severity ratings

test.description: Generate test suite (Jest/Playwright) for specified feature

sense-check.description: 8-signal Sense Check Gate assessment for phase transitions

schema.description: View, add, migrate, or validate Supabase schema

prompt.description: Create or iterate Claude API system prompts with versioning

copy.description: Write Taglish UI copy with tone variants and persona checks

compliance.description: NPC, BIR, or security compliance audit with action items

metrics.description: MRR dashboard, trend analysis, highest-leverage recommendation

triggers.git_commit: Validates staged files: no `any` types, no API keys in client code, migration RLS/soft-delete, no .env files
triggers.git_push: Warns when pushing directly from main (branch workflow enforcement)
triggers.next_build: Runs test suite before build, warns on failures

triggers.migration_sql: Validates RLS, soft-delete, user_id, audit columns on CREATE TABLE
triggers.api_routes: Checks for Zod validation, blocks hardcoded API keys
triggers.client_files: Blocks server-side API keys and env vars in client components
triggers.ai_modules: Blocks 'use client' in Claude/AI files, checks BIR disclaimer on tax content
triggers.money_handling: Warns on float money values (should be integer centavos)

notes: 12 skills + 15 commands + 2 automated hooks. Hooks enforce AKBai non-negotiable rules automatically during development. All commands include shared context loading, step-by-step workflows, and cross-skill delegation.
